fichas.title: Urns and columbarium compartments
fichas.summary: Urns hold ashes after cremation; their dimensions are normally governed by cemetery rules. Wall compartments in urn halls (columbariums) are mostly specified by width and height.

fichas.title: Mortuary and coffin compartments
fichas.summary: The mortuary accommodates the deceased until the funeral. Coffins are laid out in compartments separated by lightweight half-height partitions. Larger facilities may separate the coffin-bearer passage from the mourners’ viewing passage. Requirements also cover hearse access, environmental control, cleaning, and supporting rooms.
uses: Hold deceased persons until the funeral
Provide coffin viewing before burial or cremation

fichas.title: Crematorium and cemetery chapel
fichas.summary: The crematorium includes an incineration room, a combustion chamber, coffin transport, and supporting spaces. The combustion chamber may be below the chapel or behind the assembly room, separated by a lobby. A chapel serves mourners and multiple denominations, with clergy rooms and ancillary facilities; administration and garden-service areas are also described.
uses: Transport coffins to the combustion chamber
